gaps.explanation: Statement lines come from the proprietary Statement of Cash Flows (p7): suppliers 66,596 + employees 37,814 + capital assets 11,654 + interest 10,622 + loan principal 11,326 = 138,012. Detail lines come from the Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p6): total operating expenses 155,804 + interest expense 10,622 = 166,426. The non-depreciation operating expenses (1,302 + 24,489 + 40,805 = 66,596) equal cash paid to suppliers and personnel 37,814 equals cash to employees; the difference is depreciation 51,394 (p6, not a cash payment) less cash paid for capital assets 11,654 and loan principal 11,326 (p7, not expenses): 51,394 - 11,654 - 11,326 = 28,414 = gap -28,414. Both printed figures are correct; no fix.
